candidate_sentence_map.S10: Marketing expenses were broadly stable at €69 thousand, and administrative expenses declined to €270 thousand from €297 thousand.

candidate_sentence_map.S16: Total interest-bearing liabilities increased to €16.568 million from €15.215 million, and net loans rose to €15.455 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: The weighted average interest rate declined to 8.2% as Euribor decreased.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Equity increased slightly to €19.842 million, although the equity ratio declined to 46.4% from 49.9% at year-end.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Operationally, four apartments were sold during the quarter.

candidate_sentence_map.S22: Pre-sales are expected to begin in Q2 2025, alongside planned construction starts for Spordi Street and Soodi 6.

factual_claims.claim: Arco Vara reported a marked improvement in financial performance in the first quarter of 2025 as Estonia’s residential real estate market showed moderate signs of recovery.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The first quarter of 2025 continued the moderate recovery in Estonia’s real estate market that began at the end of 2024... The continued decline of the Euribor, alongside stabilizing inflation, contributed to increased transaction activity and consumer interest, particularly within the residential segment.

factual_claims.claim: Revenue increased to €1.706 million from €0.990 million in Q1 2024, an increase of €716 thousand, or approximately 72%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: In Q1 2025, the group's sales revenue was 1,706 thousand euros, which is 716 thousand euros more than the sales revenue of the Q1 2024 of 990 thousand euros.

factual_claims.claim: Revenue from the sale of own real estate rose to €1.589 million from €927 thousand, while service revenue increased to €117 thousand from €63 thousand, supported mainly by higher franchise fees and rental income.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Revenue from sale of own real estate: 1,589 (Q1 2025) vs 927 (Q1 2024). Revenue from rendering of services: 117 (Q1 2025) vs 63 (Q1 2024). Other sales revenue in 2025 mainly includes revenue from franchise fees... Franchise fees for the Q1 2025 were 65 thousand euros, franchise revenues for the Q1 2024 were 55 thousand euros.

factual_claims.claim: The group returned to profitability.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: In Q1 2025, the group’s operating profit (=EBIT) was 259 thousand euros and net profit 103 thousand euros. In Q1 2024, the group’s operating loss (=EBIT) was 208 thousand euros and net loss 349 thousand euros.

factual_claims.claim: Operating profit was €259 thousand, compared with an operating loss of €208 thousand in the prior-year quarter.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Operating profit/loss (EBIT) Q1 2025: 259, Q1 2024: -208 (in thousands of euros)

factual_claims.claim: Net profit was €103 thousand, or €0.01 per share, versus a net loss of €349 thousand and a loss per share of €0.03 in Q1 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.claim: The improvement was primarily reflected in the Estonian development segment, which generated €1.589 million of revenue and €320 thousand of operating profit, compared with an operating loss of €128 thousand a year earlier.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: External revenue by segment - Estonian development: 1,589 (Q1 2025) vs 935 (Q1 2024). Operating profit/loss by segment - Estonian development: 320 (Q1 2025) vs -128 (Q1 2024)

factual_claims.claim: Bulgarian development remained loss-making, with an operating loss of €76 thousand, while the Estonian construction segment recorded a €46 thousand operating loss.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
